Perfect. Now tap 'TripSnap' at the top left to go back, and then turn off 'Tracking' or 'Allow Tracking' on that main page.
Ah, you're right. We have to go to the main Privacy settings for that. Tap 'Settings' at the top left, then find and tap 'Privacy & Security'.
Great, you're on the right page. Now tap 'Tracking' just below Location Services.

cues.action: tap Allow Apps to Request to Track

cues.text: Oops, you turned off the global tracking setting, which stops all apps from asking. Turn 'Allow Apps to Request to Track' back on, and then just tap the toggle next to TripSnap in the list below to turn it off.

cues.action: tap Allow Apps to Request to Track

cues.text: Perfect, that's exactly right. You've successfully stopped TripSnap from finding your location, refreshing in the background, and tracking you across other apps, without affecting any of your other apps. You're all set!
